healthy.title: Healthy release
healthy.description: The frozen model and serving features agree. Paired quality should pass.

feature_skew.title: A silent feature bug
feature_skew.description: Serving zeros returning users' topic, subtopic and title affinity. Latency can stay healthy.

score_shift.title: Drift without ranking loss
score_shift.description: A monotonic score transformation changes distributions but preserves every ordering.

regression.title: A bad model release
regression.description: The candidate reverses scores. Labels are needed to establish quality loss.

missing_feature.title: An upstream data defect
missing_feature.description: Affinity features become missing and are imputed at serving time; the monitor records the defect.

delayed_labels.title: Labels arrive late
delayed_labels.description: Only 35% of outcomes are available at the first evaluation; the gate must withhold a verdict.

sparse_slice.title: Too little evidence
sparse_slice.description: Replay only 16 impressions. A perfect-looking score is insufficient evidence.

semantic_ranker.title: Autoregressive semantic IDs
semantic_ranker.description: Compare a trained taxonomy-token generative baseline with the frozen discriminative ranker.

requirements.boundary: Measured local experiments; historical replay cannot prove business lift.

requirements.implementation: Feature/score distributions, missing data, paired training-serving skew, latency and linked traces.
requirements.boundary: Drift is diagnostic. Quality conclusions require joined outcome labels.

requirements.implementation: Durable inbox, idempotency, fenced leases, atomic projections, Kafka adapter and analytical sink.
requirements.boundary: Single-host WAL is verified locally; multi-service mode has a separate integration check.

requirements.implementation: Crash recovery exercises, durable transport deployment and a multi-zone design proposal.
requirements.boundary: A local lab cannot establish multi-zone availability or production scale.

requirements.implementation: Request-keyed outcome joins, late-label delivery and explicit coverage thresholds.
requirements.boundary: Recorded clicks describe original offered sets, not counterfactual reactions.

requirements.implementation: One JSON model contract, shared CLI/API/UI, repeatable scenarios and CI.
requirements.boundary: One implemented ranking feature schema; new feature pipelines require code and validation.

requirements.implementation: SDK spans, bounded Prometheus labels, provisioned dashboards and optional OTLP.
requirements.boundary: Inference durations exclude network and queue time unless explicitly measured.

requirements.implementation: Semantic taxonomy IDs, trained autoregressive token likelihoods and constrained candidate decoding.
requirements.boundary: Count-based learning baseline; no transformer training or learned semantic quantization claim.

requirements.implementation: Real Ollama calls, OpenInference conventions, invalid-output checks and matched comparators.
requirements.boundary: Small live smoke evaluations are insufficient for a release-quality claim.

requirements.implementation: Recommendation/ranking, click-scoring features, local language models and a digit-image classifier.
requirements.boundary: No production ad auction, search index or large vision-serving fleet.

requirements.implementation: Strict event schemas, pseudonymous identities, no raw prompt capture, retention procedure and audit trail.
requirements.boundary: Local trusted developer mode; enterprise authentication/RBAC is a deployment exercise.

requirements.implementation: Design decisions, ownership, SLO proposals, capacity model and failure-domain analysis.
requirements.boundary: Architecture exercises complement production leadership evidence from the résumé.

requirements.implementation: Onboarding contract, rollout plan, incident workshop and mentoring/review prompts.
requirements.boundary: A personal project does not establish actual organizational adoption or influence.

requirements.implementation: Python services, versioned contracts, correctness tests, integration workflow and reproducible evidence.
